title: Circuit stabilizer: connection quieting and tenant SLO-tilt hotpatch
author: Priya Natarajan
release_notes: Hotpatch: introduce connection quieting to prevent oscillatory circuit reopen storms; add tenant-level SLO tilt metric used by the regional shedder; fix reconciliation race in circuit-state reconciler; bump telemetry to include quiet-window events.
body: Motivation: During an incident on 2026-02-14 we observed rapid circuit reopen/reclose oscillations for certain islanded regions which amplified load and caused tenant-level SLO violations. Root cause analysis showed two compounding issues: (1) the circuit reconciler could race when reconciling restored health probes and reopen attempts, and (2) the shedder decision logic treated all SLO deficits equally, causing aggressive shedding for tenants where small latency increases were acceptable and for others where impact was severe. This PR introduces a targeted hotpatch that (a) adds a short 'connection quieting' window after a circuit state change to prevent immediate reopen retries, (b) introduces a tenant SLO-tilt score that biases the regional shedder away from high-impact tenants when feasible, and (c) fixes the reconcilation race by serializing state transitions through a single reconcile queue per-region. The change is intentionally conservative: default quiet window is 3s and tilt weight defaults to 0.2 to avoid large policy swings. Changes: - core/slo/tilt.go: new tilt scoring util and config hooks that expose a per-tenant weight used by the shedder. - serving/circuit/reconciler.go: serialized region reconcile queue plus idempotent transition checks to prevent flip-flopping. - serving/circuit/quieting.go: small in-memory LRU that tracks recent transitions and prevents reopen attempts until quiet window expires. - serving/shedder/region_decision.go: incorporate tilt score into weighted shedding decision; maintain preferred fallback model selection when high-tilt tenants are present. - telemetry/events.go: emit QuietWindowStart/QuietWindowEnd and TiltScoreComputed events. - integration/e2e/quieting_test.go: deterministic test that simulates probe flapping and asserts no oscillatory reopen. Backwards compatibility and rollout: defaults preserve current behavior for customers who do not tune tilt or quieting via runtime config. Feature is behind a runtime flag `enable_connection_quieting` (true in this hotfix rollout). We will canary the change to the US-west region for 24h before global rollout. Observability: added two new histograms (quiet_window_duration, tilt_score) and two counters for quieting hits/misses. Telemetry tags include tenant_id and region. Checklist: - [x] Unit tests for tilt scoring and reconcile queue - [x] Integration e2e that reproduces the incident pattern - [x] Telemetry emits validated in CI - [x] Manual canary in us-west for 24h - [x] Documentation note in CHANGELOG and runtime flags section Risks and mitigations: The quiet window could increase recovery latency for true healthy nodes; mitigated by keeping default low (3s) and exposing config for operators. Tilt weighting could under-shed a tenant that contributes to global load — the weight is advisory and the shedder still enforces capacity caps. Rollback plan: revert runtime flag or roll back the deployment; reconciler changes are backward-compatible because they are serialized but do not change transition semantics. Contact: SRE on-call + Priya for triage.

review_comments: Ethan Park: Nice focused patch. Two asks: can we add an exponential backoff cap to the quiet window if a connection flips repeatedly? Also add a small dashboard in the telemetry PR for quick ops visibility.
Priya Natarajan: Reply: added an adaptive cap in quieting.go (LRU now tracks flip-count and caps to 15s). Telemetry dashboard note added to docs/runtime_flags.md.
Marco Ruiz: Please add a regression test that asserts tilt does not drop below 0.0 or exceed 1.0 under adversarial scores.
Priya Natarajan: Reply: added unit test in core/slo/tilt_test.go and guardrails in tilt.go to clamp scores.
post_merge_notes: Canary started 2026-02-22 16:00 UTC in us-west (10% of control plane traffic). No regressions after 18h. Quiet hits/misses show expected pattern; tilt_score distribution skewed toward 0.1-0.4 for high-impact tenants. Will schedule global rollout on 2026-02-25 pending final SRE signoff.
observability_changes: Added quiet_window_duration histogram (ms), tilt_score gauge; emitted QuietWindowStart/End and TiltScoreComputed events with tags: tenant_id, region, model_family; updated dashboards: Regional SLOs -> Quieting summary panel.
rollback_instructions: Disable runtime flag enable_connection_quieting or revert hotfix deployment; fall back to previous reconciler by reverting commit b3f1c67,e5d3b48 and redeploying. Notify SRE and product owners if rollback is performed.
